name: basecn
summary: shadcn/ui-style React components rebuilt on Base UI — copy source and own it.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of ~50+ documented components — not full inventory.
Replacement for SKIPPED base-ui-net (Angular/Ply) in Packet 044 queue.
Depends on Base UI (@base-ui/react), not Radix — migration notes on site.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Button rebuilt on Base UI with familiar shadcn-style variants.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add https://basecn.dev/r/button.json

# or with registries.@basecn configured:
# npx shadcn@latest add @basecn/button
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

<Button />

copyPrompt.text: Use basecn free MIT component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://basecn.dev/docs/components/button. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add https://basecn.dev/r/button.json` or `npx shadcn@latest add @basecn/button` after configuring `"registries": {"@basecn": "https://basecn.dev/r/{name}.json"}` in components.json. Registry item: https://basecn.dev/r/button.json. Built on Base UI (`@base-ui/react`) with shadcn-style copy-paste ownership. Requires React/Next + Tailwind. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/akash3444/basecn/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2025 basecn). Pricing free.
